task: Serotonin (5-HT) system CERT (couples nerve-conduction + dopamine/monoamine + gut/enteric + psychiatric): (1) synthesis, tryptophan -> TPH -> 5-HTP -> 5-HT, TPH1 (peripheral/gut) vs TPH2 (neural), two separate genes for one rate-limiting step; (2) reuptake by SERT (the SSRI target), Michaelis-Menten kinetics; (3) receptor diversity, 7 families (5-HT1-7), 5-HT1A somatodendritic autoreceptor vs 5-HT2A etc. FALSIFIER: does the model reproduce the SSRI PARADOX (SERT blockade ~80% occupancy at clinical dose by PET, Meyer 2004, but antidepressant effect takes 2-4 weeks -- explained by 5-HT1A autoreceptor desensitization) AND the ~90%-of-serotonin-is-gut/enteric fact (peripheral vs CNS pools separate, BBB-divided) -- refuting naive 'gut serotonin sets mood'? Decorrelated check: tryptophan depletion transiently lowers mood in REMITTED (SSRI-treated) but not healthy subjects (Ruhe 2007 meta), a causal-but-conditional link, honestly bounded. Symmetric-QC: the 'chemical imbalance/low-serotonin theory of depression' is NOT supported by direct evidence (Moncrieff 2022 umbrella review) -- held OPEN, not resolved; SERT-occupancy-vs-efficacy dissociated (different claims: drug-target engagement vs baseline etiology).
confidence_tier: in-vivo-anchored (PET SERT-occupancy, Meyer 2001+2004; human tryptophan-depletion RCTs meta-analyzed, Ruhe 2007; a human pindolol-augmentation RCT, Perez 2001) for the SSRI-paradox/autoreceptor-desensitization falsifier (Parts 2-3). The peripheral/CNS pool-separation falsifier (Part 4) is mouse-genetic-anchored (Cote 2003 Tph1-KO, Alenina 2009 Tph2-KO, Savelieva 2008 double-KO -- three independently-generated genotypes from the same gene-targeting research program) plus a human/rodent PMC-full-text quantitative anchor (Yano 2015, >90%) -- NOT human-causal-manipulation-anchored (cannot ethically knock out human TPH1/TPH2), disclosed as a residual limitation. The symmetric-QC leg (Moncrieff 2022, Part 6) is systematic-umbrella-review-anchored at the largest available human sample sizes (n up to 115,257) but is itself CONTESTED (8 published comments, incl. a direct rebuttal) -- reported as open, not adjudicated.
